title: Administration
intro: Moderation queue, member accounts, team content and the log of decisions.
refused: This page is reserved to the administration team. Your account has no access to it.

queue.heading: Reported or hidden content
queue.author: Author: {{author}}
queue.reasonHelp: Written in the log of decisions, 500 characters at most.
queue.emptyOpenText: Content of this type reported by members will show up here.
queue.emptyHiddenText: Content of this type hidden by moderation will show up here.

consequence.hide: Readers no longer see it. Its author and the team still do.
consequence.restore: The content is visible again and its reports are closed.
consequence.remove: It disappears for every member and no longer earns points for its author.
consequence.block: The content leaves the reading pages and the queue for good.
consequence.suspendBlog: No post of this member can be read while the blog is suspended.

proposals.heading: Proposed services
proposals.reasonHelp: Sent to the member in the answer e-mail, 500 characters at most.
proposals.emptyText: Services proposed by members will show up here.

accounts.heading: Member accounts
accounts.search: Handle or start of the e-mail address
accounts.searchHelp: Leave empty to see the latest sign-ups.
accounts.caption: Accounts found
accounts.suspendText: All their sessions and tokens stop. They cannot sign in until the account is reactivated.
accounts.reasonHelp: Between 3 and 500 characters, written in the log of decisions.
accounts.reactivateText: The member can sign in again.
accounts.emptyText: Check the handle or the start of the e-mail address.

content.heading: Team content
